title: Current state of LLM Risks and AI Guardrails

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using intrinsic methods like the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) and extrinsic task-specific benchmarks such as the Winogender dataset (for pronoun resolution tasks). Also evaluated via counterfactual evaluation by altering gender attributes in text and observing model output changes.

Evaluated intrinsically using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) and Sentential Embedding Association Test (SECT) to measure association scores between race-related target words and positive/negative attribute words.
Evaluated using extrinsic task-specific benchmarks like the StereoSet dataset, which measures biases across NLP tasks such as sentiment analysis and question answering.
